reason: The hypothesis cites no prior evidence (supporting_evidence_ids is empty). The key premises regarding the feasibility of the specific laser alloying process, the critical Al concentration for protective alumina scale formation on refractory HEAs, and the quantitative improvement in oxidation resistance are all specific claims requiring experimental support, which is entirely absent.
premises: Laser surface alloying can enrich the top ~50 μm of a refractory HEA surface with ~5 wt% Al.
A surface Al enrichment of ~5 wt% is sufficient to form a continuous, adherent Al2O3 scale on a refractory HEA at 900°C.
A continuous, adherent Al2O3 scale formed at 900°C in air will reduce oxygen uptake by 30-50% compared to an untreated refractory HEA.
